title: The 5 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Wet Food
h1: The 5 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Wet Food
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for automatic pet feeders for wet food, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at automatic pet feeders for wet food using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cat Mate C500 Digital 5-Meal Automatic Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 sealed compartments, each holding up to 3/4 lb of food, Included ice packs sit beneath the compartments, Digital timer with initial feed plus 4 scheduled meals.
strengths: Purpose-built for wet food, not adapted from a kibble auger design
Ice packs are the single biggest freshness advantage in this category for wet food
5 individually sealed compartments open only at their scheduled time, keeping the rest cold and covered
limitations: 5-meal limit means it needs refilling and re-icing more often than a large dry-food hopper
Ice packs need to be refrozen between uses, adding a maintenance step
No camera or app, so there's no remote confirmation a meal actually opened
features: 5 sealed compartments, each holding up to 3/4 lb of food
Included ice packs sit beneath the compartments
Digital timer with initial feed plus 4 scheduled meals
Runs on 3 AA batteries for over a year of use

products.name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
products.blurb: Key specs: Sealed lid closes over the bowl between registered visits, Suitable for both wet and dry food per the manufacturer, Microchip and RFID collar tag recognition.
strengths: Sealed lid slows drying and odor between meals better than an open timed-release bowl
Doubles as a food-theft barrier if wet food is only for one pet in a multi-pet home
Suitable for prescription wet diets that need to stay off-limits to other pets
limitations: No active cooling, just a sealed lid, so the multi-hour freshness window is shorter than an ice-pack feeder
Single bowl at a time, not multiple pre-loaded meals like the Cat Mate C500
Higher price for what is fundamentally a single-bowl feeder
features: Sealed lid closes over the bowl between registered visits
Suitable for both wet and dry food per the manufacturer
Microchip and RFID collar tag recognition

products.name: Cat Mate C300 3-Meal Automatic Pet Feeder
strengths: Ice pack helps keep wet food fresh
Runs about a year on AA batteries
limitations: Only three meals, one of them manual
Ice pack effectiveness drops in hot rooms

products.name: Cat Mate C200 2-Meal Automatic Pet Feeder
limitations: Battery powered with no low-battery app alert

products.name: Closer Pets 5-Meal Automatic Pet Feeder
strengths: Five timed meals for portion control
Works with wet or dry food
